definitions.explanation: An extreme reaction of surprise or shock at something unexpected. Stronger than ordinary surprise, implying the person is so startled they metaphorically look up at the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was astounded by the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The people around him were astounded by his remark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ほど⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The price was so high that I was shocked when I heard it.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to express extreme surprise or shock. The word literally means "looking up at the sky" (⟦{仰|あお}ぐ→仰ぐ：11454_aogu⟧ + ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧), evoking the image of someone so startled they throw their head back. Often appears in the pattern {仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be astounded)
- {仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧ (shocking news)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仰天|ぎょうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be astounded at ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧: to be surprised — more general and milder
- ⟦びっくりする→びっくりする：01178_bikkurisuru⟧: to be startled — more colloquial
- ⟦{唖然|あぜん}→唖然：09404_azen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be dumbfounded — emphasizes speechlessness
